description: Read a local file at an absolute path and store its bytes as a blob. The agent supplies only the path; the platform reads, derives metadata (filename, mime_type, source_path, byte_count, artifact_type), and persists the blob. Returns the blob_id.
embedding_description: Store blob from file. Ingest finished render, upload audio file, persist binary artifact, load image from disk. Agent supplies absolute file_path; The solet reads bytes, infers MIME, persists. Use for FLAC/M4A/MP3/WAV renders, JPEG/PNG/WebP cover art, MP4/MOV video, PDFs. Returns blob_id for downstream upload_track / etc. Path must be absolute.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that file was read from disk and stored as a blob. Contains blob_id (unique identifier), namespace, and merged metadata.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result. The returned blob_id can be passed directly as a blob reference to subsequent actions.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reading a local file from an absolute path and storing its bytes as a blob
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: file_path_not_absolute: file_path must be absolute. file_not_found: no file at the supplied path. file_not_regular: path exists but is a directory or other non-regular entry. file_unreadable: file exists but cannot be read (permission denied). file_empty: file is zero bytes. mime_type_unknown: extension did not yield a MIME type and none was supplied explicitly.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For file_path_not_absolute: provide an absolute path. For file_not_found / file_unreadable: confirm the path and read permissions. For file_not_regular: pass a real file, not a directory. For file_empty: confirm the upstream step produced output. For mime_type_unknown: pass mime_type explicitly.
